replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design includes a password login that gates enrolment; credential stuffing attack and account takeover are concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Design explicitly stores refresh token in plain app storage; backup/other-app read is a concrete disclosure path."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Design states biometrics only unlock the screen; local-only check bypass yielding authenticated session is concrete."},{"id":"T4","keep":false,"reason":"Same attack (token lifted from plain storage) and harm (account impersonation) as T2.","duplicateOf":"T2"},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Single stored long-lived token with no stated rotation/revocation; persistent access after password change is distinct harm."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Biometric result stays local and token lacks device binding, so dispute/revocation gap follows from design."}]}
